records.source: A very special gift that would delight anyone.
An extremely juicy fruit that grows in hot, humid weather. Slightly sweet with a sour undertone.
records.translation: Napakamakatas na bungang tumutubo sa mainit at mahalumigmig na panahon. Bahagyang matamis na may maasim na lasa.

records.source: Plant these in the summer. Takes 13 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tag-init. Tumatagal ng 13 araw upang mahinog.

records.source: No one knows how these form. Some scientists claim that the microscopic structure displays unnatural regularity.
records.translation: Walang nakaaalam kung paano nabubuo ang mga ito. Sinasabi ng ilang siyentipiko na nagpapakita ng di-likas na pagkakapare-pareho ang mikroskopikong kayarian.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: Despite having a toxic stinger, these fish are shy and prefer to avoid humans.
records.translation: Kahit may makamandag na pantusok, mahiyain ang mga isdang ito at mas gustong umiwas sa tao.

records.source: Julienned vegetables on a bed of rice.
records.translation: Mga gulay na hiniwang pahaba sa ibabaw ng kanin.

records.source: A common material with many uses in crafting and building.
records.translation: Karaniwang materyal na maraming gamit sa paglikha at pagtatayo.

records.source: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng bato, mga mineral, o mga Heoda.

records.source: Break apart to obtain stone with a chance of coal.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng bato at magkaroon ng tsansang makakuha ng uling.

records.source: Lasts longer than a wood fence.
records.translation: Mas matagal itong masira kaysa sa bakod na kahoy.

records.source: A bizarre fish that's shaped like a brick.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to decorate your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o palamutian ang iyong mga sahig.

records.source: A sweet, juicy favorite with an appealing red color.
records.translation: Matamis at makatas na paboritong prutas na may kaakit-akit na pulang kulay.

records.source: Plant these in spring. Takes 8 days to mature, and keeps producing strawberries after that.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 8 araw upang mahinog at patuloy na namumunga ng mga strawberry pagkatapos.
